notes.sv: För heltidsstudenter folkbokförda i Sverige som studerar eller ska studera utomlands. Ansökan mailas med studieintyg och ett personligt brev; vinnare utses i januari.
notes.en: For full-time students registered as resident in Sweden who are studying or about to study abroad. Applications are emailed with proof of enrolment and a personal letter; winners are chosen in January.
